transformation_goal: Convert a commodity keyboard into independently positionable left/right halves while preserving rational donor reuse and normal keyboard functionality.
applicability_constraints: key matrix or equivalent input topology must be characterizable
proposed physical separation must have an evidence-backed modification plan
known_incompatible_or_high_risk_variants: uninspectable multilayer routing across required cut corridor
fragile membrane tails with no reliable retermination method
proprietary integrated assemblies where donor reuse cost exceeds replacement

decision_graph.choose_when: matrix bridging burden and physical routing remain defensible
retained matrix regions are reusable but shared-controller bridging is excessive
donor PCB cannot be safely/economically divided

required_measurements: continuity mapping for ambiguous row/column nets
known_failure_modes: mechanical cut damages retained trace or mounting structure
maturity_note: A real first completed keyboard would justify OBSERVED only. REPLICATED requires multiple sufficiently independent artifact-backed instances.
